summary.headline: Universal Method of House Judgments
summary.text: Concludes rules for causes and circumstances of death: fiery or watery significators indicate death by heat, fire, snow, or water; fortunes in the eighth house signify a good death, while infortunes indicate a foul or shameful one, with Mars linked to iron or fire and Saturn to poison, food, or medicine. Chapter 38 introduces the universal method for judging the twelve houses by examining fortunes, infortunes, aspects, and house lords.
